|errata_history=This is a pre-release (playtest) image of [[Han Solo (V)]] (its only version): the PC published it before Virtual Set 24 was officially released (30 December 2024), so it is not the original (Bill, 12 November 2026: pre-release images are Playtest versions; only the image at official release is the original). The current text is [[Han Solo (V)]] (Original). Each version is the Players Committee's own card image, quoted in full with its upload date; the image on each page is that version's image as published (unchanged). The PC card data (swccg-card-json) is cited as dating evidence only.

* '''Original''' ([[Han Solo (V)]]): the card image at official release (29 December 2024, with the PC's Set 24 errata and fixes)<ref name="ht-efc26cd">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/hansolo.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual24-Light/large/hansolo.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba efc26cd] “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”, 29 December 2024, with the PC's Set 24 errata and fixes. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114014729/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections381-batch2-primary-sources.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref> prints: “[Pilot] 3. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Adds one battle destiny with Chewie. While piloting ''Falcon'', adds 2 to maneuver and, once during battle, may re-circulate.” '''What changed:''' The words of the game text are unchanged. The starship name “''Falcon''” in the game text is now printed in italics (roman type on the first image). It is a version of its own because the PC published a visibly different card image (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC image is its own version). The card image prints no errata mark.
*: The lower part of this card image (the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name) was also printed as a slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 24 release sheet<ref name="sheet24-20250202">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (PDF, 3 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2024”; file created 2 February 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 24]] (30 December 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114014729/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections381-batch2-primary-sources.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref>, page 2, file created 2 February 2025, under the label “•Han Solo”. Same words ([[:File:V24-L-hansolo-2025-02-02-sheet-slip.png]]). Under the slip-and-composite rule (Bill, 17 November 2026) the slip is part of this version, not a version of its own.
